name: Crusader C2 Hercules in an extra-large high-tech hangar

tractor_beam.provenance: Fallback only. With the archive (FFI), the values come from the record at run time (sc_datacore_record: the SWeaponActionFireTractorBeamParams whose name is action; maxForce / minDistance / maxDistance / fullStrengthDistance / maxVolume; log CARGO_TRACTOR source=datacore). These are the values of LIVE 4.10.2 Data.p4k (docs/cargo/datamine.md, Drone and tractor references), used without the archive (Web build, SC_WITH_FFI=0). maxVolume is read in SCU, the unit the boxes occupancy volume is authored in (SStandardCargoUnit): one beam takes 20 SCU, so a 16 SCU box needs one drone and 24 / 32 SCU boxes need two.

flight.note: Viewer choices, not game data (sway: gusts in atmosphere, less under load): the game has no cargo-drone entity (docs/cargo/datamine.md). A loaded team accelerates at (N F - m g) / (N drone_mass + m), at most max_accel; a team keeps at least min_load_accel.

atmosphere_note: The hangar is pressurised: drones sway in gusts. No data signal names a room's atmosphere (viewer setting).
